sources.snippet:
Title: 【商業英語】踢走港式英語
# 【商業英語】踢走港式英語. 現在whatsapp、LINE、Wechat等手機通訊程式極為普及，大部份香港人時刻都使用它們與同事、朋友、甚至老闆和客戶聯繫。可是，大家在whatsapp等上所打的，往往都不是正確的英語，而是港式英語。潛移默化下，逐漸養成在日常生活及職場上用港式英語的習慣。. 筆者在不少面試及會議時，經常聽到應徵者或同事頻頻用港式英語，或是把中文直接翻譯成英語，聽起來不三不四的，而在場的外籍人士更是一頭霧水。為免在重要場合失禮，影響自己及公司形象，大家應多加注意以下一些香港人在文法、詞彙和詞組方面的常犯港式英語例子。. 2. What means "a la carte"?✗. What **does** "a la carte" **mean**? 3. How to spell "a la carte"? 4. I very hate presenting in front of others. 5.  I want to cut my hair. I want to **have my hair cut**./ I want to **have a haircut**. 6. The boss maybe right. The boss **may be** right./ **Maybe** the boss is right. 7. No one helps me to open the computer. No one helps me to **switch/ turn on** the computer. 8. There had so many employees working on the weekend. 9. My friend is so man. My friend is very **manly**/ **masculine**. I am Hong Kong people. I'm **a local**./ I'm **from Hong Kong**./ I'm **a Hongkonger**./ I'm **Hong Kongese**. I will borrow you my staff handbook. I will **lend** you my staff handbook. I was so boring in the meeting. I win you in the staff competition. I **beat** you in the staff competition. I don't like listening the CEO. I hear internet radio programs on weekdays. I **listen to** internet radio programs on weekdays. I am agree with the other colleagues on this matter. **It is difficult for me** to find a job during this economic downturn. 1. Will I have any jetso（著數）if I help you? What's in it for me if I help you? 2. Hey boss, I love your outlook（外表）today! Hey boss, I love your look/ outfit today! 註："Outlook"是指「展望」，與外表完全無關，如"Hong Kong's economic outlook"（香港的經濟展望）。. 1. Open the door, see the mountain. 2. People mountain, people sea. I will give you some colour to see! I will teach you a lesson!✔. 4. You ask me, me ask who? MA in English Language Teaching, BSc (First Honour), TEFL Dip. 現代教育IELTS/ TOEFL /Workplace English資深英語名師，著名TOEFL參考書作者及星島日報IELTS攻略專欄作者。曾任劍橋商業英語考試BULATS寫作及口試考官，並於國際大型英語學院任教多年並擔任其多間分校校長，具十多年教學經驗，並具豐富管理與發展商業英語及國際英語考試課程經驗。. facebook: frankieps.chan@gmail.com. email: frankieps.chan@gmail.com.
